changes_allowed: readout expression only; no added parameters, normalization, skip, new losses, scan directions or context rescaling

scan.h0: zero for production; nonzero h0 tested

training: exact locked Phase17R schedule/optimizer/dropout/innerEMA/freshouterrefit; no new hyperparameter selection

parent_training.schedule: constant; outer refit exact inner-selected epochs

bootstrap.sampling: same patient counts inside frozen outerfolds for every model/seed; perseed fold comparable-pair sums before averaging seed metrics; recompute DID in each draw; conditional on fitted models

secondary: PFI frozen DSS risk transfer only; no PFI training or selection

probe.selection: first training patient/WSI in original manifest; labelblind, never outer-error selection
probe.diagnostic_states: small probes only, production chunked; position is a geometry order, not biological time

decision.readout_helpful: L0-F0 and L1-F1 mean deltas positive in both H and Uno; otherwise stop S6 repair
decision.condition_candidate: L1-L0 and DID positive for H and Uno, each at least2of3 positive seeds, no harm in both-metric mean versus ANCHOR_CS and R1_A3_noDirect; historicalCONCH32 reported as different-input reference
decision.strict_evidence: Bonferroni8 interval perprimarymetric; non-significance is not equivalence

historical_reuse: only after SHA/source/partition/epoch/preprocessing/software/feature and full checkpoint replay checks; count model references separately from new fits
privacy: only anonymous aggregate cells, source and diagnostics public; patient OOF/weights/gene identities/raw arrays/credentials private
scope: limited exploratory 2x2 on repeatedly developed cohort; local y=C h is standard SSM readout, not a new Mamba algorithm
